text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of highest education 5. Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Band 7 for Liberal Arts and Band 4 for Sciences 7. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents
